comments.body:
Preserve-current-code: Limit this preservation question to compile-time-disabled packed storage.

Keep PR #4737's short-row stores, deferred conversion, and completion publication after the helper join. This question applies only when k_vnni::layout_on<geometry.kv.head_size> is false, including TRON_K_VNNI=OFF. That branch has no packed blocks or shared save. Could it retain the original per-token copy-and-publish loop?

The all-store-then-publish order was introduced by the earlier shared-save commit 0b54de7a10. It already exists at PR #4737's base, 30c4ac82cb, at model.hpp:3040–3053. PR #4737 separately delays in-place layout conversion until readers have finished (78582b7ba3).

This is an optional scope-preservation question, not a demonstrated performance defect. Insufficient data: measurements isolating the two-pass ordering in the disabled-layout branch. Do not apply this suggestion to row-major tail blocks while packed storage is enabled.

Estimated final PR diff impact: 8 fewer changed lines. Basis: an independently counted, uncompiled draft, including required caller, comment, and test changes. This is a size estimate, not performance validation.

comments.body:
Preserve-current-code: Skip packed-layout bookkeeping when TRON_K_VNNI is disabled.

The new unconditional k_forget_row call scans the storage slots and reads two atomic masks per active slot (lines 2557–2568). With TRON_K_VNNI=OFF, layout_on is false for every geometry, and the production packed-layout writers do not run.

Please guard this call with TRON_K_VNNI and leave the existing kv_saves_ reset outside the guard. The enabled block stores, conversion, and scoring stay unchanged. This narrows the affected execution paths; it does not reduce the textual diff or remove the unconditional metadata arrays.

comments.body:
Preserve-current-code: Limit store_block to the complete blocks production actually writes.

Both production callers pass FULL_BLOCK_0XFFFF: page::set_k_block at kv_cache.hpp:2282–2283 and block_to_vnni at k_vnni.hpp:508. Short runs already use set_k_row in model.hpp:3300–3319. The partial-mask loads and stores therefore have only test callers at this head.

Please remove the mask parameter, conditional row loads, masked-store branch, and partial-mask-only test cases. Retain the full-block transpose/store and tests that compare its bytes and verify neighboring blocks remain unchanged. This removes unused capability while retaining the production store used by the AMX optimization.

comments.body:
Preserve-current-code: Remove the unused packed-K copy_token overload and its dedicated test.

Its only caller is the new section at t/t_k_vnni_layout.cpp:192–209. Production cache copies use owner assignment for whole pages and layout-aware row operations for partial ranges (kv_cache.hpp:2732–2762). They do not call this helper.

Please drop this K overload and its test section, while keeping the separate packed-V copy_token overload and the production cache-copy tests. No production AMX store, score, or copy path depends on the removed helper.

conditional_proposal.body:
Preserve-current-code: Consider reusing tron::barrier before maintaining a second shared-save protocol.

The existing barrier already provides main-thread phase setup, per-helper phase tracking, and completion waits (threading.hpp:895–936). A dedicated instance reset for the main helpers could replace opened, finished, helper_windows, and the custom wait loops while retaining the work-unit table and shared block stores. The existing greedy_range can also supply dynamic claims.

Treat this as a prototype requiring measurement. The existing latch diagnostics do not match the new aborting watchdog, and equivalent TPS/TTFT has not been established. Keep the current synchronization until those differences are resolved and the reduced version is benchmarked.
